description_en:
A complete blood count (CBC) is a blood test that evaluates the cells in your bloodstream. It measures red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets to detect a wide range of disorders including anemia, infection, and leukemia.

  • Red blood cell (RBC) count
  • White blood cell (WBC) count with differential
  • Platelet count
  • Hemoglobin
  • Hematocrit
short_description_en: Comprehensive blood panel measuring red cells, white cells, and platelets.
